name: allura-scout
description: Low-token context discovery for Allura workflows. Produces compact evidence-backed ContextPackets before agents plan, build, or review.

interface.shortDescription: Produce compact context packets before agent work.
interface.longDescription: Use Allura Scout before planning, building, reviewing, or handing off work when prior context matters. It searches only relevant files and Allura memory, avoids large dumps, and returns a compact ContextPacket for the next agent.
defaultPrompt: Find the smallest useful context for this work.
